nom: COSRX Advanced Snail 92 All In One Cream

avis.texte: I use this under my moisturizer for added hydration. I love that it is light and absorbs quickly. I feel that it helps my skin feel nourished and healthy.
I love the way this moisturizer feels! It really moisturizes my skin and doesn't break me out (which is pretty rare lol). It even helped my tattoo heal faster!
I have use this product for about two weeks and I really noticed my skin is soft and with more hydration.
Not moisturizing at all. My skin has never felt so dry. I feel like I need to apply every this couple of hours! I will go back to my former product.

Unfortunately, this was not moisturizing and didn't work well for me. I used it in the day time and it made my skin feel tight almost immediately after applying as if all of the moisture was stripped from my skin. I gave up on it about 2-3 weeks of use. I have combo skin leaning more dry and never had a cream made me feel so tight.
I love the consistency and feel of this product on my 60 yr old combination skin. I decided to try it as I already use their serum and thought it might help retain moisture. Great product.

I struggled with acne as a teenager more than I do now, after I got on curology I don't have many breakouts. This did not trigger any additional breakouts. My skin is incredibly dry but not really sensitive, this sinks into the skin slowly over the course of an hour or two. Some people don't like that but I prefer it because I need as much moisture as possible. It dries down slightly sticky but that continues to go away as the product soaks in. I got the tube version so I didn't have the messy issue. I would definitely recommend anyone with weirdly stubborn dry skin to give this a shot
I really wanted to love this product. Unfortunately, it was extremely drying and caused my skin to itch and develop a horrible rash

I have VERY dry, sensitive, acne prone skin. After much research, I decided to try this. I wanted so badly to love it, bur it left my face painfully dry in under an hour. My face was literally flaking. I even added other hydrating products, and it felt like this sucked all the life out of my skin. It may be much better for oily skin in the summer time, but definitely not dry skin in the winter.
I've purchased this many times. Its always a go to i enjoy using it as a primer as well since its tacky
As a 45-year-old individual with sensitive skin, I've found this face cream to be remarkably effective. I highly recommend it to anyone seeking a new facial moisturizer.

I love this stuff! A little amount goes a long way! I love the way it makes my skin feel. So soft and the cream isn't heavy. I have a healthy glow to my skin after using this and the price point is perfect for the amount of product you get. Love it!

Didn't have a reaction, love the texture. A little goes a long way and its a good amount for the price. I was a little concerned when i firdt out it on as it seemed to be drying down kinda tightly rather than smoothly if that makes any sense, but I used it overnight and woke up with really hydrated skin the next morning so no complaints, just trust the process. Works great with my other skincare from Derma-E and Curology.
Do not like this product it made me break out and i have pretty normal skin this has never happend to me.

I've only used this for a couple days, but so far it's great. A lot of times after I shave my moisturizers haven't helped as my facial hair grew as it still made my face itchy. This one has been the most hydrating so far. Also soaks into the skin perfectly. Also it takes VERY LITTLE to fully moisturizer your face. I'm hoping it pairs well with the cleanser!

This stuff is absolutely amazing…. I don't believe I've ever seen my skin look so healthy and glowy before. I used this stuff after I wash my face and I apply it before bed and wake up and my slim just looks so plumped and dewy. I love it! My husband even noticed my skin looked better. So that's a win.

avis.titre: This product is so good for my problem skin!
avis.texte: I'm 14, and recently I've struggled with big pores, acne scars, and fungal acne. After two uses, my pores are getting smaller, scars fading, and almost completely acne free for the first time since I became a teenager! Telling all my friends!
My skin needs this product! This has been a holy grail product for years for me. It's lightweight, absorbs well, keeps my skin smooth & hydrated.

avis.titre: Sits on skin and doesn't absorb
avis.texte: I've been using this for a couple months and at this point just trying to use up the bottle. this just sits on my skin and does not absorb. in the morning my skin feels slimy still when I wash it, but I feel like it does not moisturize well. I don't understand the hype.

avis.titre: I was surprised (in a bad way)
avis.texte: I LOVE cosrx like absolutely obsessed with the snail mucin in every way, it changed my skin in ways I hadn't seen any other product do. This product was unfortunately a let down for me, entirely. It has the same consistency just a little heavier than the mucin, but it doesn't translate the same on the skin. It dries out super fast and dried my skin out to the same point as if you'd just started using retinol, it was that bad. Mind you I have combination skin and have never had a problem with getting too dry just sometimes too oily so I was completely shocked when this dried out my skin completely. It also sadly irritated my skin as well. I actually came to the reviews to see if anyone else had the same experience.

And to be clear, I did not use the product on my eyes. But after a few uses, my eye lids developed a crazy painful, eczema like rash. Never have I experienced such a reaction from a facial product. Would not recommend if you have sensitive skin or if you ever get eczema.
Love this for my skin, ive been using this for two or three years and still love it!

I've had problems with products containing snail mucin in the past, but this product has changed that for me. It's one of the few snail-based products that does not break me out or give me fungal acne, but makes my skin clear, glossy and moisturized. It's hard for me to find skincare products that don't pill under SPF, but this is one of the best. Great for daytime any nighttime, but if you're using at night, I would recommend adding an oil ot an occlusive like vaseline to lock the moisture in, because it does dry quickly.

I use the COSRX Snail Mucin Cleanser, Power Essence Serum, Eye Cream, and All In One Cream, combined with a Mario Badescu toner and a multitude of The Ordinary treatments to form a personalized and highly effective skin care regimen that has made my skin look and feel tighter, firmer, healthier, and younger. On days when I'm in a rush, the Snail Mucin line is my go-to and is effective on its own, but combined with a few Ordinary products, it's the most amazing skin care regimen I have ever used. This moisturizing cream does have a very unique texture when you first apply it, but it is far and away the best!! It tightens, firms, moisturizes, and protects! I LOVE IT!!!
This has helped my skin so much. Its light but my skin feels hydrated
This has helped my skin so much. Its light but my skin feels hydrated

I have very dry skin and i buy this over and over its amazing!! It doesnt peel, hasnt broke me out, its very hydrating and absorbs nicely. Great under makeup just give it a couple minutes to absorb first!

avis.titre: A great product at  affordable price
avis.texte: Love the product on top of the serum, skin was able to absorb since my skin sometimes react to gel like texture and felt like my pores were enlarged trying to breath through the gel.
I was influenced to try this and cannot fugure out why people like it. Its slimy and doesnt do anything. Waste of money
Ever since I've been using this product, my skin has been incredible! It makes it glow and smooth and I've fell in love with it and I will be purchasing it again!

I love the moisturizing birch sap lotion and snail essence products by cosrx which is why I was excited to try this product. However, this product really triggered the hyperpigmentation and dryness around my chin area. It was almost a purple-brown color that I hadn't gotten since before I became invested in skincare a couple years ago. My skin also became very flaky and would get dry after about an hour of applying this cream which surprised me and I would apply more in hopes that it'd help but my skin would just get even more dry. I wasn't using any other products other than my rose water facial mist and the birch sap moisturizing lotion :(( my skin just didn't like this product at all but i gave the cream to a friend and she fell in love with it lol.

avis.titre: Best purchase I've made in awhile
avis.texte: This is amazing. Feels perfect on my skin. It feels moisturized and so soft after. This has now been added to my daily skin routine! Try it!

avis.titre: of course it's slimy!… it's literally snail mucin.
avis.texte: this is one of my favorite korean skincare products ever, i have used it for about six years now. it keeps my skin feeling fresh and hydrated, and helps prevent signs of aging. if you don't like sticky or slimy things, maybe don't order a snail mucin moisturizer? i'm confused as to why you would lol. that's the whole point! it works very effectively and mixes well with my COSRX overnight rice leave-on mask. it is pricey but a little goes a long way, and the bottle lasts a couple of months. it is not meant to be worn under makeup though, it causes pilling and patchiness.

avis.titre: I don't know how to feel
avis.texte: I liked this at first. I got the travel size to try it at first and a little does go along way. I've had it for a little over 2 months now and I don't think I've made a dent in it. And just for background I'm a highschooler with dry, eczema prone skin. But no matter what I try my skin always peels after I put it on?? I do have dry, sensitive, eczema prone skin so I do wonder if its better for oily skin. Its just not enough for my dry skin and makes my skin peel and flake no matter how many times i change my other skincare products or makeup products. It mainly peels around my forehead, chin, and nose. Other than that I don't think it did anything for my skin that would justify the price. I wouldn'f repurchase personally. Maybe if I had oily skin??
This lotion and the face wash in my everyday routine must have loved this will never change

I have sensitive skin this product cleans my face does not give me any irritation or itchiness after lose my Faith feeling refreshed and smooth. I'm always skeptical on using products to wash my face because it irritates my skin, but this is amazing.
Another great COSRX product. Moisturizes well. Can use anytime of the day. Can be use alone or with other products like the COSRX peptide skin booster.
I've been using it daily it keeps my face moisturized and isn't sticky/tacky and makes my skin look great

Lightweight , gel type moisturizer with that slightiy sticky feel you get with snail products. Perfect for under makeup as a skin prep/primer . Excellent for a daytime moisturizer or noght as well if you are oily . I prefer a heavier nighttime moisturizer as i am dry . I have very sensitive skin and am prone to rashes if there is any fragrance , essential oils or other harsh ingredients. Ive never had an issue with any cosrx product.
I love how it leaves my skin. I would definitely buy it again. My skin feels so much more hydrated after using it, and the natural glow it gives is simply amazing. I'm obsessed!

avis.titre: All in one cream.   Not moisturizer
avis.texte: This cream has improved the texture and brightness of my skin. I use it on top of my HA serum since its not just a moisturizer. It works for clearing and brightening the skin and helps make it soft but if this is your only moisturizer you wont be happy.

avis.titre: All in one cream.   Not moisturizer
avis.texte: This cream has improved the texture and brightness of my skin. I use it on top of my HA serum since its not just a moisturizer. It works for clearing and brightening the skin and helps make it soft but if this is your only moisturizer you wont be happy.

Ive been using this for awhile and it really does everything it says! I have verrry dry textured skin, deep fine lines and bad breakouts. I appy this cream along with a hyalronic acid serum and an hour later my skin has cleared up, fine lines reduced & leaves my face very hydrated & smooth. Def recommend

avis.titre: Loved it at first but think it triggered my perioral dermati
avis.texte: Used everything but the vitamin c, which smells horribly. Loved the way it went on but I think ut triggered my Perioral dermatitis. It's gotten a little better since I stopped using it, but still have a rash under my nose and on my lips. No fun.
I loved the texture and how it felt on my skin. I have very sensitive skin and after using it my face broke out in a rash. Unfortunate as I really liked the product itself.
I loved the texture and how it felt on my skin. I have very sensitive skin and after using it my face broke out in a rash. Unfortunate as I really liked the product itself.

avis.titre: Dry skin/clear skin: broke us out.
avis.texte: I have dry and sensitive skin. First night using it, gave me bumps the next morning. i only used a gentle cleanser with it so i'd like to think the breakout wasn't from a combination of chemicals/products. I thought it was just my skin being sensitive, so i asked my boyfriend to use it. He's always had clear skin (only uses water to clean his face, and did the same this time). he also woke up with acne and little bumps the next day! He never gets acne, ever. However… ive been using it on my neck and it did soften my skin there + it looks great. So i wouldn't use on my face but it's a good neck product lol. A little pearl goes a long way.

I have mature skin and this has definitely made it smoother and more plump. Almost adds a glow. A little goes a long way and I use it at night as I didn't like how it layed under my primer. I have even had some friends ask what I have been doing differently in my skincare routine because they noticed a difference.

i've been using this moisturizer for quite a while, and I've had it for months without it running out. It's very lightweight and leaves you glowing, making it look like glass skin and has gotten rid of pimples.

avis.titre: Just as good as the snail serum!
avis.texte: COSRX snail serum was out of stock when I needed more so I tried this instead. It's basically a heavier version of that, somewhere between a serum and a moisturizer. If you're oily like me this could totally replace moisturizer when it's hot & humid!

I tried this out for about a week and even though it didnt cause breakouts, I still returned it. My face felt dry and tight and not hydrating at all. It feels like it just sits on your face. I have combo skin and it just didnt work for me.

I've never written a review on a prpduct, but I had felt inclined to warn people. My skin can handle new skincare pretty well but this broke me out so bad. I have acne all over my face, especially mini bumps on my forehead. I haven't had this experience with other cosrx products, just this one. (When I returned this item, the cashier said that they experienced the same thing with this product)

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I have been using it since two months now and have noticed significant decrease in uneven spots on my face. Makes my skin soft and supple.

This product is moisturizing and doesn't break out my sensitive skin. The texture is unique (sticks to my hand when I pull it away from my face) but it is 92% snail mucin so it's nothing surprising or bothersome.

This product is working miracles on my skin. I have been playing around with my perfect skincare routine and I think this product is what I needed. My skin gets horribly dry in the winter. I'm the dry skin queen. I was using another brand night cream, but that started clogging my pores. I bought ELF Holy Hydration moisturizer and my skin felt better. I saw this on sale and I was like, this probably would help. Omg. I put this on first, let it dry, then the elf cream. This + the elf has left my skin feeling smoother than ever before. Even when I wash my face in the shower my skin feels like pillows. I *think* this product enhances the ingredients of other products. Before I put this on, I use The Ordinary Niacinamide and ABA serums. I had been using both of these serums for like 8 months, with no noticeable difference in my dark spots. As soon as I added this Snail Cream in my routine, in a month the dark spots have reduced quicker than they had the whole 8 months before. So, yeah, I'm never going back! This has completely changed my skincare and I'm feeling wonderful.

avis.titre: Finally a moisturizer my skin loves
avis.texte: My skin loves this, s littke goes a long way. I mix it with hyaluronic gel moisturizer at night for extra moisturizer to absorb throughout thr nighg snd i wake up with soft, plump, moisturized skin. I havd extremely sensitive skin and has not had a reaction with none of products by Cosrx.
Not that moisturizing and honestly such a mid product. It leaves weird flaky patches on my skin as well.

Really good and light feeling for people who are sensitive to textures. Layers well with different brands without pilling. I could feel an immediate difference after the first two days of usage which is rare in skincare.

avis.titre: Good texture and hydration, not great smell
avis.texte: I love all of the Cosrx snail mucin products and bought this without reading any reviews or researching. I've been using Missha super aqua cell renew snail cleanser for years and it's my favorite affordable hydrating cleanser. I won't be returning the Cosrx, but I doubt I will repurchase, solely because it smells like cheap dish soap to me and is unpleasant to use. It works fine, leaves my skin feeling hydrating and clean, but the smell is just off-putting for me and cheapens it. Pros: texture, hydration, lather, and no allergic reaction. Cons: price and smell
This is the best moisturizer I've ever used. This combined with the CosRx serum, and I feel like im aging backwards. My skin is tighter, smoother, and has a better complexion than it has in years!
Its not very moisturizing at all. 30 mins after applying, my face already feels super tight and dry.

I have tried several of the Korean companies latest products and I think this is the best one yet. It has become my favorite. I'm a senior male and even though I feel a little intimidated when shopping at Ulta it's worth it.
Ive used this moisturizer for almost 4 years now and nothing compares. Ive tried others occasionally and I just always go back to this. I plan to use it for the rest of my life.

avis.titre: Love this but careful if you have allergies
avis.texte: I love this cream, even better than the regular serum. I found this absorbs better for my dry, sensitive, acne prone skin. Especiallt after a peel or exfoliating wash, this really helps to repair my skin and make it so soft. I fo layer or rotate with other moisturizers though as ira not heavy enough to serve as an everfau product in the winter for me. I see so many reviews about reactions and rashes - if you have allergies or sensitivies to DUST MITES or other mollusk, you should be careful with this product. There can be cross reactivity.
I wanted to love this so bad because I love the snail mucin but this just didn't work for me. It left my skin feeling dehydrated and tight which is hard to do with my oily skin.
I use this nightly to seal in my skincare and it has changed the game. I wake up with a smoother texture in the morning and well hydrated skin even after using a cleanser.

I have combination skin. I've been using this for a couple weeks now and my skin feels amazing! A little goes a very long way. I use a pea size amount and that will do my entire face, neck, and some of my chest. I will definitely be buying again.
I love Cos rx line but...this product is one that does not work for me! Makes me skin extremely DRY! I won't be purchasing this again.

avis.titre: Don't buy if you're allergic to shellfish
avis.texte: My fault lol. If you're not allergic, I'm sure this stuff is great
I love this brand. I have the cream, serum & BHA. You get a lot for a price. A little goes a long way. My skin loves all three and it absorbs quickly.
Why was the package CHANGED from the original pot. Original was way better that this. Now I'm thinking of getting a different moisturizer, this is not worth my money if the size is now this tiny……

I heard really good things about this so I bought it. As someone who has sensitive dry skin but still has acne this did not break out my skin and made me look glowy. However, it takes a while to dry even sometimes it's still not dry in the morning. It can make you feel greasy if you apply too much. A little goes a long way. I would recommend this and is my go-to moisturizer.

avis.titre: the ONLY moisturizer you need in the summer!
avis.texte: lovely texture & absorbs quickly but, keeps your skin hydrated & dewy all day

I recently suffered a barrier break after overusing koji acid soap and leaving it on too long. After some research I bought this in store. My complexion is almost back to normal and it didn't break me out. Irritation,redness &dullness almost gone.
This is a great moisturizer it leaves my skin hydrated, smooth and glowy it's gentle on the skin and doesn't have any added in fragrance.
Should I do my serum, snail mucin and then the all in one cream, in my morning and night routine?
I tried this product a few times, several months apart each. After each use I ended up with chemical burns on my face and neck. Do not buy this product

I have been using this for almost a year and also repurchased as I have dryer skin naturally and this was very soothing. I have acne prone skin and this never causes breakouts, it's pretty neutral I feel like, so it won't cure acne but also will sooth your skin. I even feel like it's "too moisturizing" so wouldn't use on oily skin but I needed the hydration.

My dad cursed me with his sensitive skin so I'm very selective on what I put on my face. This product is amazing for my acne-prone/texture skin and doesn't leave my face feeling tacky or red. For the size bottle you get it's not terribly priced either.
It also wasn't super impressive. It was mid. It didn't cause acne / skin issues, but after 6 weeks of use i didn't feel improved them either

avis.titre: Acne Prone Oily Skin Girl Approved
avis.texte: Ive been battling acne my entire life… Im now in my early 40s and still battling it. Ive tried just about every face wash on the market since my teen years. Rarely do I find something that is strong enough to wash my face without double cleansing AND without overdrying it. Gesh I wish Id learned about this face wash sooner. It removes all the dirt, oil, and even light makeup with one wash without drying me out. Even if I double cleanse whenever I have on heavy makeup, this face wash still doesnt dry out my skin. It goes on so silky, smells good and a little goes a long way.

avis.titre: This is a miracle in my life
avis.texte: I struggle with acne spots on my face that quickly become stains or easily become scars. This product has been helping treat this greatly! I love the soft texture on my face, it hydrates so well, it creates a light layer of healing, it treats my acne scars and evens/prevents the stains. This tube applicator is also the best to deal with the "stringiness" of the product.

I can't say that it made me break out, but I can't say it was moisturizing either… I always feel like my face is very dry and tight after using it. I will try to use it during the day, right now I use it before bed, since it does not havd SPF.
Bought this product before taking a trip to california and a day after using it gave me texture of small bumps on my face until this day i havent been able to get rid of .

I read so much about this product and I thought I would try it, despite my usually basic skincare routine. I have fair, dry, very sensitive skin. But very rarely get pimples or acne, just redness sometimes. For the first week, the product seemed ok, my skin felt more moisturized than usual but that was the only difference I noticed. Then I started getting tons of little red bumps all over my face that would not go away. There was nothing else I changed that would have caused this. I kept using it for a bit longer until I finally stopped using it. That was about 4 weeks ago and the outbreak is still persisting, finally slowing down a little bit!! I also read that if you're allergic to dust mites, you are also allergic to sail mucin. So if you have sensitive skin or allergies this probably isn't for you.

I have combination skin so its really hard to find a good mositroizer that moisturizes my dry parts but not too moisturizing where it clogs my pores in the more oiler parts. But this moisturizer literally solved my needs and it leaves my skin glowy, comes down the redness in my skin, and it leaves it soft 🤭
This is a must for my skin care. I am acne prone, dry and sensitive. This product makes my skin feel amazing and it lasts forever. Im onto my third bottle of using this and ill continue to do so.

avis.titre: Would be great for oily skin
avis.texte: I have very dry skin so it wasnt quite moosturozing enough for me, and the jar gets messy which dosent make it cery practical for travel which i do often. I like the product a lot but its just not enough mositure for my skin, if you have oily skin its great, i gave it to my friend with oily skin and she loved it, but for me personally it wasnt enough moistire. Other than that its a rly good product that leaves me glowing!
I love COSRX and this cream has not been disappointing. I use it as a moisturizer and it has made my skin feel so smooth and clean.
I love how this plumps up and gives deep hydration to my skin. I'll never go without! I use it in my PM routine.

I was so excited to try this and hop on the snail mucin bandwagon. I have used it as my primary moisturizer for the last few weeks and I just don't understand what the hype is about. I can't say it has improved my skin, or that I've noticed any positive effects at all. sure, it moisturizes, but so do tons of other products out there. unfortunately I found this to be nothing special. if you're on the fence, I'd skip this one.

avis.titre: finally a moisturizer that doesn't make me more oily!
avis.texte: I've used a ton of moisturizers that are supposedly great for oily skin; philosophy, hydroboost water gel, la roche posay effaclar. I did love the effeclar but 37 bucks for less than an ounce! no thanks! I tried this one thinking it was too good to be true at this price. I LOVE it. it had a fun texture, makes my skin look beautiful, and controls oil all day. it's also helped my acne scars which is a plus!

I never expected to love this as much as I do. My skin is so oily that I really can't even wear liquid foundation because it melts off my face after a couple hours. I also suffer from acne, and enlarged pores. On the other hand, my skin can get extremely dry and flaky. Basically ny skin is a horrible combination mess. This stuff is amazing!! My skin truly has never looked so good. It moisturizes without clogging my pores. My skin has been way less oily, and I haven't broken out at all, even when it was that time of the month. I cant recommend this product highly enough. My advice is to give it a try for at least a week. You have to get past the texture, since it is snail mucin. However, I think most people will absolutely love and benefit from this product.

Beware of this product. I have never in my life anf eczema especially around my eyes. I used this for a couple of weeks and started noticing dryness and my skin feeling tight. I know it says not to use in eye area but accidents happen. I have stopped use of this and i am now dealing with eczema around my eyelids. Nothing seems to be helping the redness. If youre going to use this use extreme caution not to get it around your eye area
This immedialtey hydrates my dry and sensitive skin. It also prevents any oily appearing pores. Has really healed my skin barrier. Very happy with my purchase.

I bought this product last summer and didn't think much of it when i first tried it out. Then winter hit and my skin was so dry. This moisturizer is the only one I have that's an overnight fix for dry skin. I will always have this in my makeup bag from now on and will use this even when i dont want to use a lot of skincare. Worth every penny.

my skin has always been super sensitive to face creams and lotions so I was cautious when first trying it. my skin has never flet or looked better. between the snail mucin and this cream, my face is glowing! Where I live the winger climate is harsh and dries my skin out but this has completely fixed that, without the breakout! it feels a little greasy initially but soaks in super fast.

avis.titre: LUV LUV LUV this product, but its purpose should be clearer
avis.texte: I am a big fan of this product for its ability to calm and restore the state of my skin's microbiome. I also notice that when used long term my skin looks radiant. However, when I first used this product I had no idea it wasn't necessarily a moisturizer. I use this on top of my other serums and underneath moisturizer, and it works wonders.
I really wanted to love this cream, but it broke me out. I will still use it on my hands.

After incorporating the Cosrx Snail All In One Cream into my skincare routine, I'm absolutely delighted with the results! This cream has become a holy grail product for me. Its lightweight yet deeply moisturizing formula leaves my skin feeling incredibly soft and supple. I've noticed a significant improvement in my skin's texture and elasticity since using this cream regularly. The snail mucin extract works wonders in soothing and repairing my skin, making it look more radiant and youthful. Plus, it absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy residue behind. I can confidently say that the Cosrx Snail All In One Cream has earned a permanent spot in my skincare arsenal!

avis.titre: Good product but not for me
avis.texte: When applying the moisturizer it gives a very nice glowy-hydrated affect, but it doesn't absorb into the skin well and I would feel dry patches on my face later throughout the day. The product is very lightweight and may be good for people with oily skin, but not so great for drier skin types. It help clear my skin though.
I never had blackheads before using this product. My skin looks good with it on but I jave tiny bumps all over my face.

I have sensitive skin that is very reactive and i was hoping this would help maintain my skin barrier. It goes on nicely and seems to make my skin feel good and healthy, but i started noticing that, every time i used it, i would get really bad cystic acne. I never get cystic acne and i dont notice this with any other products so im sure it has to be this one.

This snail mucin is such an essential step in my night time routine! I apply it on damp skin and seal it in with a moisturizer. I go to bed looking like a glazed donut and my skin feels so soft in the morning!
Reduces redness right after one use! Dries out super quickly, doesnt absorb skin ‼️ i pair it with their serum HOLY GRAIL my skins texture immediately improved

This cream is honestly incredible. I've used the regular cosrx mucin but this is next level. I have the most sensitive, reactive skin of anyone I know and this keeps my skin calm, soft & hydrated. No breakouts, no irritation whatsoever. So grateful 💗
I didnt have a breakout for a long time. Within 2 days after using this product, i start seeing. I dont want to use the product.

avis.titre: Don't use if you have eczema
avis.texte: I wanted to like this so bad but it gave me a horrible eczema breakout on my forehead. I have eczema on my body but I've never had a breakout on my face until trying this.
